s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss with scotomas following high-intensity light exposure
salient_findings: Vision loss and scotomas in the right eye after LED light exposure
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers on OCT
Disruption of ellipsoid zone and outer segment photoreceptor on OCT
key_facts: 13-year-old female presented with vision loss and scotomas
Exposure to high-intensity LED light at close distance
Initial BCVA: 6/20 right eye, 20/20 left eye
Anterior segment examination was unremarkable
Fundus examination was unremarkable
OCT showed hyperreflective area at external retinal layers
OCT showed disruption of ellipsoid zone and outer segment photoreceptor
FA showed no leakage
Serial SD-OCT findings showed mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space
mfERG showed decreased foveal peak P1 amplitudes at 19 days
mfERG showed improved foveal peak P1 amplitudes at 33 days

shortlist.label: Phototoxic maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: High-intensity LED light exposure at close distance, consistent with phototoxic maculopathy

shortlist.label: Solar retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Similar presentation to solar retinopathy, with vision loss and scotomas after light exposure

shortlist.label: Photic retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Retinal damage from light exposure, consistent with photic retinopathy

shortlist.label: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Acute vision loss with scotomas, and outer retinal layer damage on OCT

shortlist.label: Central serous chorioretinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Vision loss and scotomas, with possible serous retinal detachment or retinal pigment epithelium disruption

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including vision loss, scotomas, and OCT changes, are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy, which can occur after exposure to high-intensity light, such as the handheld high-intensity LED light in this case.

rejected.label: Solar retinopathy
rejected.why: Solar retinopathy typically occurs after direct gaze at the sun, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Photic retinopathy
rejected.why: Photic retinopathy is a broader term that encompasses phototoxic maculopathy, but the specific findings in this case are more consistent with phototoxic maculopathy.

rejected.label: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy
rejected.why: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy typically presents with a distinct clinical and imaging profile that does not match the findings in this case.

rejected.label: Central serous chorioretinopathy
rejected.why: Central serous chorioretinopathy typically presents with serous retinal detachment and leakage on FA, which is not seen in this case.

gold: Photic maculopathy derived from LED light exposure
